items.defectStatement: The translation accelerator caches results without including SiteSetting.default_locale, although fallback translations now depend on it. Cached text can therefore come from the wrong fallback locale after a default-locale change or when switching between sites with different defaults.
obligations: Prevent cached translations from being reused across different site-default fallback locales.
Make default-locale changes affect subsequent translations without restarting the process.
Preserve the user-locale, site-default, English fallback order.
items.notes: The anchor defines the intended fallback order; the defective cache lookup is in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb. Partitioning by default locale or reliable invalidation is valid; site identity alone does not handle default-locale changes. The frozen input omits the cache implementation.

items.defectStatement: Fallback catalogs are explicitly preloaded only by ApplicationController#set_locale, while the translation accelerator loads only the current locale. Jobs and mailers can consequently miss translations available in unloaded site-default or English catalogs.
obligations: Make required fallback catalogs available to translations outside controller requests, including in a fresh worker.
Resolve fallbacks using the active site's default locale and the requested locale.
Preserve fallback order and working request-time translations.
items.notes: The cited preload call is valid but cannot cover execution paths that never enter this controller. A fix requires shared translation/loading changes or coverage of non-request entry points, whose implementations are absent from the frozen input.
